values.note:
This is how long the song or mixtape is.

A song does not need to be leaked to have a length added if the length of the song is known.

The date that entry leaked, released or surfaced online 

NOT the date that track/project was made

KEY

OG - 
Original Version of a released or mostly finished track

Demo - 
Demo of an unreleased or throwaway track

Ref Track - 
A track someone makes that isn't intended for themselves, but rather to be used as a reference for someone else

Feature - 
Throwaway where Kanye is just a feature

Remix - 
Unreleased or unavailable remix by someone notable

Unknown -
We just don't know what it is. Usually only applies to Ref Tracks, Throwaways, and OGs

Other -
Does not fit with any of the other types of leaks listed here

Throwaway - 
A completed track that was never released

Snippet: Fraction of the track.
Partial: Longer than a stereotypical snippet, but not the full track.
Full: Entire track

Confirmed: Said to exist by people who have worked with Kanye in the past

Rumored: Said to exist by reputable people within the leak community. Please take with a grain of salt

FLAC: 16/44.1kHz or greater
CDQ: 320kbps+
HQ 128kbps up to 320kbps
LQ: Anything lower
Recording: Recorded second hand

Most people can't tell the difference between FLAC, CDQ & HQ; LQ is noticeably worse.
